# Assessment Overview

This directory contains the supplementary assessment documents that were generated for the current report version.

- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - Documents the MVC routes, request and response contracts, and the storage communication flow.
- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - Shows the application layers, storage integration, and component relationships.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Traces the core gallery workflows for browsing, uploading, and deleting images.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Inventories the application configuration sources, settings, and secret handling approach.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Summarizes the blob-based persistence model, ownership boundaries, and storage access patterns.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Groups the project dependencies by function and highlights compatibility risks.
